expectations.text: The reply reports the uncaught JSON parse error (SyntaxError) captured from the page console or page errors after the click
expectations.evidence: After clicking in headless Chromium, the agent reported that the page threw "Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 12 (line 1 column 13)" and that `#out` was still empty; the reply never uses the word "SyntaxError", but this is the uncaught JSON.parse error captured as a page

expectations.text: The reply names the malformed JSON literal (missing closing brace) as the cause
expectations.evidence: The reply says "The JSON string it parses is missing its closing brace" and quotes `JSON.parse('{"total": 12');   // missing closing }` at app.html:5.
